runs.entry: The v5 re-run order, unattended work-hours cycle, one dispatched analyst under the canonical brief, from scratch. The brief's departures: the repository path after the move of 2026-10-25; the lines of evidence and competitors derived by the analyst from the filings; the company files no 10-K, so the 20-F shell company report's incorporated sections of the 424B3, the F-1 of 2026-09-11 and the 6-Ks stood in for Items 1, 1A and 7. Price **$1.47** (close 2026-10-28, aggregator, flagged) x **31,639,454 ordinary shares** (20-F shell company report cover, accession 0001213900-26-092139; F-1 0001213900-26-099277 gives fifteen fewer) = cap **$46.5M**; sovereign **5.37%** (US Treasury 30-year par, 2026-10-28; reporting currency USD, the dirham pegged). Filings: the 20-F above, the F-1, the 424B3 0001213900-26-076389, DRS 0001213900-26-001168, 6-Ks 0001213900-26-090327, 0001213900-26-093258 and 0001213900-26-108018, Schedule 13D 0001213900-26-092779, S-8 0001213900-26-112479. tools/run.py and Screens/cover_shares.py both failed on the new IFRS 20-F filer; every figure from the filed statements. **Q1 OUT**: a start-up; cost of revenue above revenue every filed year (FY2023 $761K on $224K, FY2024 $1.14M on $519K, FY2025 $4.71M on $1.37M); the Hialeah plant not yet operating and needing $20M to $25M more; going-concern paragraph on FY2025 (Grant Thornton, Dubai), loss $27.5M, accumulated losses $40.5M; the plan a US consumer brand the three filed years do not describe. Alternative reading TOO HARD (NATURE), closing alike. Q2 to Q12 NOT REACHED. Balance sheet: two audited year-ends only; equity deficit -$7.5M (2024) to -$23.1M (2025) to -$169.8M as adjusted at closing; inventory 9 times FY2024 revenue; material weaknesses reported in earlier filings; 117,037.282 Series A preferred with Accrued Value $117.0M at closing, 12% a year paid in kind, full-ratchet conversion reset, holder put at full value from the fifth anniversary, booked as a liability; warrants for up to 12,204,036 shares at $12.00 with the same ratchet; up to 20,000,000 earnout shares; the F-1 registers up to 230,515,880 shares at an assumed $1.00. Facts after the stop, recorded not judged: a $9.95M loan from a director-affiliated shareholder (Tau Capital) in 2024 to buy back shares; $3.83M in 2025 to repurchase the founder's and a former director's shares with a mutual release; insiders converting notes the day they subscribed; a 2026-10-08 election of home-country practice to issue large blocks of shares without shareholder approval; the Second Spring stock priced at no less than $3.00, about 30.8M new shares at today's price. Competitor row, whole company from their own 10-K facts: Coca-Cola gross 59.3% to 62.1%, operating 21.2% to 28.7%; PepsiCo 53.3% to 55.1% and 12.2% to 16.2%; Primo Brands 22.4% to 31.5% and 0.5% to 8.6%; WATR gross -240%, -119%, -244%. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash after all spending and lease principal FY2023 about -$3.1M, FY2024 -$16.93M, FY2025 -$20.01M, average -$13.35M, negative every year; every filed year used as a CONVENTION of the run; the no-growth case alone; net debt $79.4M with the Series A preferred counted as debt; value -$10.37 a share; fair price all-equity -$6.73, equity-only -$4.22; no positive value on any case. Could not get: FY2023 lease payments and balance sheet, the Forms 3, the S-8 plan text, the preferred's reset definitions. Framework gaps for the operator: start-up undefined (OUT or TOO HARD); a window of fewer than five years; a series negative in every year and a negative fair price; a cash-puttable PIK preferred on the all-equity basis; IFRS 16 leases on the all-equity basis; tools/run.py and cover_shares.py on a new 20-F filer. Dispatcher's check: check_framework PASS; no E-ids, all 13 ids in the ledger, 13 adjacent fragment pairs checked by `dispatcher_cite_check.py`, none flagged; no tracked research file over 200 KB; raw filings in the ignored cache. Contamination declared: other names' commit subjects, the git status listing and the memory index; none names WATR, none used. Position note filled at the fold: not held. Not armed: the box is not OUT at Q7 or IN.
runs.narr: OUT at Q1: a start-up making drinking water from air, sales below cost of sales in every filed year, its US plant unbuilt and its auditor doubting it continues; a $117.0M puttable preferred accruing 12% in kind against a $46.5M market cap; insider buybacks funded by a related-party loan; computation only, owner cash negative every year, value -$10.37 a share against $1.47. Not armed.
